scale: 1 = no capability, 2 = pilot only, 3 = productised in one BU, 4 = productised group-wide, 5 = differentiating vs market

capabilities.name: Single-asset predictive maintenance
capabilities.evidence: Deployed on 2,300 rotating assets; 11% unplanned-downtime reduction verified FY25
capabilities.gaps: Model retraining is manual; no cross-plant transfer learning

capabilities.name: Fleet-level autonomy orchestration
capabilities.evidence: Aurora pilot only — single cell, 6 robots, licensed third-party orchestration layer
capabilities.gaps: No multi-cell coordination, no fleet scheduler, no roadmap approved beyond the pilot. Dependent on an external SDK we do not control.

capabilities.name: Vision-based quality inspection
capabilities.evidence: Shipped in 31 customer installations; strongest win rate of any product line
capabilities.gaps: Hardware sourced externally; margin compression if supplier moves up-stack

capabilities.name: Industrial data fabric / unified namespace
capabilities.evidence: Two plant pilots on third-party middleware; no group standard
capabilities.gaps: No native offering. Core DCS platform is single-vendor and the data layer is effectively controlled by that vendor.

capabilities.name: Agentic workflow automation for operations
capabilities.evidence: No group capability. Two departmental tools purchased outside the architecture roadmap.
capabilities.gaps: No strategy, no owner above department level, no security review of the tools in use

capabilities.name: Robot foundation models / physical AI
capabilities.evidence: Research licence against a third-party API; no internal model work
capabilities.gaps: No in-house capability, no data strategy for robot telemetry, no build/buy position

capabilities.name: Systems integration and commissioning
capabilities.evidence: 1,400 engineers; recognised as the primary reason customers select Meridian
capabilities.gaps: Scales linearly with headcount; not software-leveraged

capabilities.name: Motion control hardware
capabilities.evidence: Group's historic profit engine; #2 global share
capabilities.gaps: Commoditising; software attach rate is the strategic question
